name: Fontana Police Explorers
what_you_do: Learn how a police department works. Explorers help in records, at the front desk and with detectives and traffic, and can go on patrol ride-alongs.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 20 and a half. Keep C or better grades, give at least 22 hours of service a month, and have a good background. You must go to at least one Explorer meeting before you apply.
duration: Ongoing. Meetings every Tuesday (not holidays), 5 to 8 pm, plus at least 22 volunteer hours a month.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Go to a Tuesday meeting first, then apply online.
how_to_apply: Go to a Tuesday meeting. Then fill out the online application. Bring a background packet to the police front desk with your birth certificate, Social Security card and current grades.
notes: Meetings are at the police station, 17005 Upland Avenue. To ask questions, call Officer D. Romero at (909) 356-7157 or Jacqueline Ayala at (909) 350-7758. The program runs on gifts from the public.
